sloka: तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे पुनरागम्य राक्षसाः ।कुम्भकर्णमिदं वाक्यमूचू रावणचोदिताः ।। ६.६०.८९ ।।।।
transliteration: tathetyuktvā tu te sarve punarāgamya rākṣasāḥ ।kumbhakarṇamidaṁ vākyamūcū rāvaṇacoditāḥ ।। 6.60.89 ।।।।

translations.english: Formidable and courageous Kumbhakarna also got up from sleep saying 'yes' and rose up.
